tasks.short: Prepare statistical data for committee, regulatory or client reports.

steps.what: Verify actual analysis population, dataset version and recipient-specific reporting requirements
inputs: actual approved analysis plan
actual checked statistical datasets
actual recipient requirements
outputs: checked statistical reporting inputs

steps.what: Prepare statistical data tables and listings in statistical reporting software {OTHER}
inputs: checked statistical reporting inputs
actual table/listing specifications and analysis code
outputs: draft statistical reporting data and provenance

steps.what: Check final statistical reporting data against datasets, specifications and recipient disclosure scope
inputs: draft statistical reporting data and provenance
checked statistical reporting inputs
outputs: checked final statistical reporting data package

steps.what: Save checked final statistical data for inclusion in the specified report
inputs: checked final statistical reporting data package
outputs: saved actual report inclusion data package

tasks.design: Configure native result-linked table and listing specifications in statistical reporting software {OTHER}, using versioned data from {DATA_PLATFORM}. The biostatistician verifies populations and requirements, fully checks final data and saves the exact report-inclusion package.
tasks.previous_blocker: Data preparation may repeat table assembly and formatting after specifications exist.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reusable specifications can assemble repeatable statistical reporting outputs.
tasks.still_hard: Population definitions, analysis validity and disclosure scope require complete review.
tasks.human_edge: The biostatistician detects a technically correct table that answers the wrong clinical question.
tasks.altitude: Less manual reporting assembly; statistical checks remain intact.

evidence.claim: The digest identifies pharmaverse admiral and rtables for derived datasets and table building; this supports reusable reporting components, not local savings or automatic scientific approval.

assumptions: Actual study data owners supply versioned datasets and analysis plan; biostatistician verifies populations and requirements in s1. New specifications, source exceptions and first-pass numerical checks stay within retained s2.
Only repeated manual assembly loses time. Existing programmed outputs, automated derivation and computation runtime earn zero saving. Full final verification remains in s3.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native reporting tools first. Task prepares data for inclusion, not an assumed direct regulatory submission; any actual send is a separate final-version-gated action with no saving claimed here.
Routine save retains one percent and consumes the existing final check; no new self-approval work. Actual reporting package work is counted once across studies/articles.
research_questions: Can native specifications reduce assembly after complete numerical verification?

incremental.description: Maintain actual table specifications and validation comparisons.

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked final statistical data package and exact report/project destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 40*0.50 repeated assembly = 20; minus 2 upkeep = 18. Half eligible gives 10 minus 2 = 8. Inputs, final checks and save retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan or direct life-science research studies.

steps.what: Retrieve and verify actual study question, prior evidence, feasibility and resource constraints
inputs: actual scientific question
actual prior studies
actual resource and recruitment constraints
outputs: checked research-planning evidence

steps.what: Plan or direct actual life-science study design, methods and research priorities
inputs: checked research-planning evidence
actual scientific and operational team input
outputs: actual study design choices, assignments and limitations

steps.what: Record and check actual study plan, chosen methods and authorised assignments
inputs: actual study design choices, assignments and limitations
outputs: checked final actual study plan and assignment destinations

steps.what: Save the checked final actual study plan
inputs: checked final actual study plan and assignment destinations
outputs: saved actual study plan

steps.what: Send exact checked study plan and assignments to authorised research team members
inputs: saved actual study plan
checked final actual study plan and assignment destinations
outputs: delivered actual study direction and assignments

tasks.design: Configure native evidence and version links in {DOCS} and {PROJECT}. The biostatistician retains scientific design, team direction and actual plan capture, then checks, saves and separately distributes the final authorised plan.
tasks.previous_blocker: Study planning can repeat navigation between actual evidence and operational constraints.
tasks.enabler_now: Native evidence links can reduce retrieval without choosing a research design.
tasks.still_hard: Feasible and informative life-science studies require scientific judgement and coordination.
tasks.human_edge: The biostatistician balances scientific value, uncertainty and practical constraints.
tasks.altitude: Less evidence navigation; research design and direction stay human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native document/project links can support research-planning retrieval; they do not confer scientific or study-start authority.

assumptions: Actual investigators and operational owners produce scientific questions, prior evidence and resource constraints; verification remains in s1. Actual design, calculations/specification choices, consultation and assignments remain in s2.
Planning and directing are a provisional task mix, not two mandatory events. Shares are not measured baselines. Native links first; existing linked access earns zero saving.
Actual plan capture and final check remain retained in s3. Routine save/send each retain one percent and use existing final checks after the plan exists.

Send covers direction within actual authority only; study initiation and any required independent approvals remain actual separate duties after final protocol exists, with no saving assumed. No fabricated sponsor, ethics or regulatory approval.
research_questions: Can native links shorten preparation without reducing scientific planning?

incremental.description: Maintain actual study evidence and version links.

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked final study plan and exact internal destination; edits require recheck
s3 checked final study plan, assignments and exact authorised team recipients; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20*0.40 evidence navigation = 8; minus 0.5 upkeep = 7.5. Half eligible gives 4 minus 0.5 = 3.5. Design, direction, plan capture, save and send retained.

tasks.short: Prepare articles for publication or conference presentation.

steps.what: Choose actual article findings, interpretation, target venue and permitted disclosures
inputs: actual checked study results
actual author contributions and interpretation
actual venue instructions and disclosure permissions
outputs: chosen article content, references and venue requirements

steps.what: Assemble actual article figures, tables and references in statistical reporting software {OTHER}
inputs: chosen article content, references and venue requirements
actual checked result outputs and reference metadata
outputs: draft article figures, tables and reference list

steps.what: Prepare article prose for publication or presentation from actual author findings
inputs: chosen article content, references and venue requirements
draft article figures, tables and reference list
outputs: complete draft article or conference text

loop.purpose: Draft article prose from actual author choices
loop.input: Actual findings, interpretation, checked result outputs and verified references
loop.check: Biostatistician checks numerical meaning, unsupported causal claims, limitations, source fidelity and omitted author choices
loop.stop: Missing author interpretation or two failed revisions returns prose to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native venue headings and reference formatting first; scientific explanations vary

steps.what: Check final article against actual findings, references, author choices and venue requirements
inputs: complete draft article or conference text
chosen article content, references and venue requirements
outputs: checked final article preparation version

steps.what: Save the checked final article preparation version
inputs: checked final article preparation version
outputs: saved actual article preparation version

tasks.design: Configure native venue headings, reference formatting and result-linked figures in {DOCS} and statistical reporting software {OTHER}. Bound article drafting to actual author choices; the biostatistician fully checks the final preparation version before saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Article preparation can repeat formatting and prose after findings are established.
tasks.enabler_now: Native assembly and bounded source-linked drafting can reduce production effort.
tasks.still_hard: Scientific contribution, interpretation and accurate limitations require author judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The biostatistician recognises overstated evidence or a misleading account of the study.
tasks.altitude: Less article production; authorship judgement remains human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native reference/figure assembly and bounded prose drafting can support scientific article preparation; they cannot establish scientific claims or publication permission.

assumptions: Actual study authors produce findings and interpretation, selected and checked in s1. Actual original source metadata is verified; missing results or citations remain manual. Retained s3 includes capture/correction of actual author meaning.
Existing automated figure/reference outputs earn zero saving; only actual manual assembly and prose count. Shared result preparation under 16244 is counted once, not claimed again here.
Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native templates first. Full final scientific check remains retained. Save retains one percent and consumes the existing final check.

The task prepares articles; journal/conference submission and presentation are not assumed completed. Actual submission must be its own gated send after the exact final version has actual coauthor/disclosure approvals; no saving or authority is assumed for that separate duty.
unknowns: Which article preparation is repeated manual work?
research_questions: Does drafting reduce prose effort after complete scientific and source review?

already_counted.description: Capture and correct actual article meaning within s3.

incremental.description: Maintain actual venue templates, source links and scientific prose checks.

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final article preparation version and exact project destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20*0.40 assembly + 25*0.30 prose = 15.5; minus 1.5 upkeep = 14. Half eligible gives 7.75 minus 1.5 = 6.25. Findings, full final review and save retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Monitor trial procedures and data quality.

steps.what: Check actual trial dataset versions, procedure requirements and monitoring scope
inputs: actual trial data and provenance
actual established procedures
actual authorised monitoring scope
outputs: checked monitoring inputs and approved check definitions

steps.what: Compare collected trial data with defined quality and procedure checks in trial software {OTHER}
inputs: checked monitoring inputs and approved check definitions
outputs: candidate discrepancies with exact source records

steps.what: Monitor adherence and verify actual data quality through investigation and study-team discussion
inputs: candidate discrepancies with exact source records
actual study-team explanations and supporting records
outputs: actual verified monitoring findings and unresolved issues

steps.what: Record and check actual monitoring findings, evidence links and query wording
inputs: actual verified monitoring findings and unresolved issues
candidate discrepancies with exact source records
outputs: checked final monitoring record and actual query destinations

steps.what: Commit the checked final actual monitoring record
inputs: checked final monitoring record and actual query destinations
outputs: committed actual monitoring record

steps.what: Send exact checked discrepancy queries to the authorised study data owner
inputs: checked final monitoring record and actual query destinations

tasks.design: Configure native fixed quality/edit checks in trial data software {OTHER}, reading actual versioned study data from {DATA_PLATFORM}. The biostatistician investigates candidate discrepancies, retains procedural monitoring and records verified findings, with separate gated record commit and query delivery.
tasks.previous_blocker: Monitoring may repeat fixed comparisons before substantive investigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native configured checks can surface exact-source discrepancies for investigation.
tasks.still_hard: A discrepancy does not establish a protocol breach or authorise changing investigator data.
tasks.human_edge: The biostatistician distinguishes a real quality problem from expected study-specific variation.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated fixed comparison; investigation and monitoring decisions stay human.

evidence.claim: The digest describes Medidata Clinical Data Studio listings review, query management and reconciliation; this supports native monitoring checks, not automatic conclusions or local savings.

assumptions: Actual study data owners produce records with subject/event identifiers, dates, values, status and version. Biostatistician verifies scope and definitions in s1; missing source access or check definitions remain manual.

S2 retains new check specifications, exception review and source validation. Only actual repeated manual fixed comparisons lose time; existing edit checks and runtime earn zero saving. Actual observation, investigation, discussion and record capture stay retained.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native checks first; field/procedural monitoring without digital comparisons must be reweighted. Actual outcomes are recorded only after investigation, never inferred from planned checks.

Save/send each retain one percent and consume the existing complete final check. Queries request investigation; no source-data correction or protocol-change authority is assumed. Only actual required queries are included.
unknowns: Which fixed comparisons are still manual?
research_questions: Can native checks reduce comparison effort after full discrepancy investigation?
